title: Legacy Direct PAN Payment Processing (v1)
summary: Legacy v1 architecture allowing raw PAN card payloads directly on POST /v1/payments/charge; superseded by ADR-004 tokenized vault architecture.

title: Nightly Batch Ledger Settlement
summary: Legacy nightly batch settlement job reconciling payments into finance tables; superseded by ADR-008 synchronous write-ahead double-entry ledger posting.

title: 30-Day Informal API Deprecation Notice
summary: Informal 30-day Slack notice before breaking API contract changes; superseded by ADR-010 mandatory 180-day Tier-0 breaking-change freeze.

title: Tokenized Card Vault (tok_pci_v2) & 45ms Fail-Closed Fraud Gate
summary: Mandates PCI-DSS 4.0 card tokenization using tok_pci_v2_<32hex>, 45ms synchronous fraud scoring via api-fraud-score-v1, and fail-closed rejection on > $500 charges; supersedes ADR-001.

title: Idempotency Keys & Exactly-Once Financial Commit Semantics
summary: Mandates client-supplied UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key headers with 72-hour deduplication windows and atomic commit semantics across payments, checkout, billing, orders, and ledger APIs.

title: Zero-Trust Service-to-Service mTLS & Short-Lived OIDC Tokens
summary: Mandates zero-trust mutual TLS (mTLS) and 5-minute scoped OIDC bearer tokens minted by svc-auth (api-auth-token-v2) for all east-west service calls.

title: Asynchronous Event Envelope & Dead-Letter Queue Contract
summary: Standardizes CloudEvents-compatible asynchronous event envelopes, correlation trace IDs, exponential backoff, and dead-letter queue replay across notifications, webhooks, and analytics.

title: Double-Entry Ledger Write-Ahead Posting & Reconciliation
summary: Replaces nightly batch settlement with synchronous write-ahead double-entry posting on svc-ledger (api-ledger-post-v2) guaranteeing zero drift and SOX auditability; supersedes ADR-002.

title: Inventory Soft-Lock Reservation & 15-Minute Expiry TTL
summary: Establishes 15-minute TTL soft-lock inventory reservations on svc-inventory (api-inventory-reserve-v1) with automated expiry cleanup and saga release on failed payments.

title: Tier-0 API 180-Day Breaking-Change Freeze Policy
summary: Enforces a mandatory 180-day Tier-0 API breaking-change freeze with dual-version parallel rollout and Architecture Review Board sign-off before deprecating contracts; supersedes ADR-003.
